component.name: Classipod
component.summary: iPod Classic-inspired player for local music and Subsonic/Navidrome streaming

description.p: ClassiPod brings an iPod Classic-inspired click wheel to local music and your own Subsonic-compatible server, including Navidrome. Browse both collections together, or hide local music while your server is enabled.

ul.li: Browse songs, artists, album artists, albums and genres; search your collection and create ClassiPod playlists.

Select a parent music folder and scan nested folders. Cache metadata and artwork, refresh or reindex, exclude folders, inspect missing tracks, and optionally hide duplicate filenames without deleting files.
Play MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, Ogg, Opus, AAC and more, depending on the installed playback backend.
Shuffle songs or whole albums in disc/track order, repeat a song or queue, seek through tracks and control volume.
Set a sleep timer for 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes, or the end of a song. Restore the previous queue and selected song, paused at the beginning.
View embedded lyrics when available, rate songs, and use Linux MPRIS media controls for playback and track information.
Choose light/dark themes, device colors including OLED Black, and Original or Big Cover Flow layouts with artwork reflections.
Use click wheel or touch controls, bundled click sounds, split-screen previews and fullscreen Immersive Mode

description.p: Local files work offline. Streaming requires your own compatible server, account and network connection. Server audio is not downloaded for offline use; server playlists are not synchronized. Ratings and edits stay in ClassiPod. Native credentials use OS secure storage; Linux requires a Secret Service provider.
Changes since 1.12.0: Subsonic/Navidrome streaming, sleep timer, album shuffle, playback-session restoration, dark/OLED themes, Cover Flow layouts, Linux MPRIS and fullscreen support.
Improved large-library indexing, metadata/artwork caching, sorting and navigation; fixed startup hangs and stream recovery.
